game.name: Adventure
game.desc: One of the earliest action-adventure games. Explore a kingdom of castles and mazes to find an enchanted chalice stolen by an evil magician. Notable for containing the first known video game Easter egg.

game.name: Pitfall!
game.desc: Run through jungles swinging on vines, jumping over obstacles & collecting treasures in this pioneering side-scrolling platformer.

game.name: Combat
game.desc: Two-player tank and biplane combat across 27 game variations. The pack-in title that launched with the Atari 2600.

game.name: Space Invaders
game.desc: The port that quadrupled Atari 2600 sales. Defend Earth from descending waves of alien invaders in this timeless classic.

game.name: Breakout
game.desc: Bounce a ball to break through rows of bricks. Simple concept, endlessly addictive gameplay.

game.name: River Raid
game.desc: Fly a jet up a vertically scrolling river, destroying bridges and enemy vehicles while managing fuel. Carol Shaw's masterpiece & one of the first games designed by a woman.
